ABOUT THIS PREVIEW

A world in the making.

This is an interactive website prototype, using RAO’s improved artwork. The PvP loop is a product-design direction, not a statement that every feature is live.

Rankings use illustrative characters, and a game download has not been connected. This Apocalipsis effect is a website adaptation. Casting and the essence walk are separate from gameplay and the game’s economy.

Use the navigation, click a keeper, or press C to choose a spell target. Keys 1–4 open sections. Pause freezes the world; reduced-motion preferences are respected.
